{{Nickname}}
The '''crown prince of Thisspias''' was a [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a part of the [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Crown/Legends|crown]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] by the [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Thisspias)/Legends|Imperial governor]] of Thisspias, although he was eventually liberated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and, following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], claimed the title of [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarch]] as a result of a [[Thisspias civil war|civil war]] on Thisspias.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
